title: Baby Dodds's early drumming and LaRocca again
summary: He says Baby Dodds played with Buddy Petey and recalls LaRocca living on Third Street.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Do you remember anything about Baby Dodds, the drummer, when he got his instrument? Do you remember when he started playing? Was he playing when he was working?
Yeah, he used to play with some boys they called Buddy Petey. That was the dad he was playing with.
While he was at the bag factory?

I don't know, I believe he was playing then. Go walking and play with him. Buddy Petey. Oh yes, I never knew him but I knew his stepfather but I never knew Buddy. That's who he used to play with. All them old players, like the other boys, I don't know much of them. Yeah, this La Rocca used to live just across the street from Wild Estate on 3rd Street. Some boys used to brag on him good. I believe he died in California. California. And so...
